program.title: Undergraduate Minor Program in Business
uncertain: total_required_credits (18.0) is the stated minimum total for the minor (PDF: 'complete a minimum total of 18 credits').

Compared with 2025-26, the 2026-27 catalog restructured this minor: List 1 (Business Fundamental) gained ACCT 2200, and List 2 (Business Advanced) is now open-ended - 'any courses offered by the departments under SB&M at 3000-level or above' - instead of an explicit list of ~21 named courses.

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: SBM SB&M Electives: courses from the specified elective list, of which at least 4 courses must be taken from the list of Business Fundamental Courses (List 1). A maximum of 2 Business Advanced Electives (List 2) can be counted towards the Minor Program requirements. No more than 1 course within the same course groups of ACCT 2010/ACCT 2200, ECON 2103/ECON 2113/ECON 2123, FINA 2203/FINA 2303, and MGMT 1110/MGMT 2110 may be counted towards the elective requirement. The group for each course is given in 'areas'.
